feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Boy, 6, dies in hospital after house fire that killed four members of his family
articles.summary: A six-year-old who sustained critical injuries during a house fire that killed four members of his family has also died, police said.

articles.title: Two dead after bus carrying schoolchildren crashes in France, officials say
articles.summary: A seven-year-old girl and an 18-year-old boy have been killed after a bus crashed in eastern France, French authorities said.

articles.title: Breakaway league LIV Golf to fold after filing for bankruptcy
articles.summary: Breakaway men's league LIV Golf is to fold instead of launching a new version because of a lack of financial support.

articles.title: Family of footballer who died after on-pitch collision pay tribute to him
articles.summary: Family, friends and teammates gathered for the funeral of the Spanish footballer who died following an on-field collision with another player.

articles.title: Meghan's brother a 'person of interest' in child abuse image claims
articles.summary: Meghan Markle's half brother has been named as a "person of interest" in an investigation into child sexual abuse image allegations against the Duchess of Sussex's father.
